concepts.name: 캘린더 배지
concepts.prompt:
Create one production-quality mobile UI concept for TripLOG’s collapsed itinerary summary, 390 × 844 CSS pixels, app content only. Current date: 2026-10-28; preserve the example trip dates 2026-10-20 through 2026-10-24. Show three collapsed day summaries, not expanded itinerary lists.

Use TripLOG’s white surfaces, dark navy text and outlines, small offset shadows, yellow #fff05a primary accents, pastel blue #bce6fb and pink #f7afc7. Use readable Korean product typography around 14–16px. Header: TripLOG, “일정 계획”, “도쿄 여행”, “10.20–10.24”, and tabs “일정 편집 / 일정 요약”, with summary selected. Keep a five-item bottom navigation: 개요, 일정, 지출, 리포트, 설정.

Explore a calendar-badge layout: a confident compact date tile anchors each white day card, while large numbers and colorful emoji-style icons organize the remaining information. Dates: Day 1 / 10.20 화, Day 2 / 10.21 수, Day 3 / 10.22 목. Show time ranges and itinerary counts as clear icon-and-value pairs: 13:00–21:20 / 8곳, 09:15–22:00 / 12곳, 06:53–22:20 / 13곳. Preview a few short place names with colorful icons and a remaining-count indicator. Example places: 나리타공항, 멘야무사시, 도쿄도청; 메이지신궁, 타케시타도리, 시부야 스카이; 에노시마, 고토쿠인, 요코하마. Make expansion obvious with a chevron and the short label “상세”. Include a compact copy icon action.

Remove all log-like sentences, warnings, missing-input notices, explanatory paragraphs and long arrow-separated place strings. Communicate through spacing, iconography, numbers and short names. Avoid nested bordered boxes, oversized decorative imagery, phone hardware and OS chrome. Produce one coherent screen, not a comparison board.
